title: Projectile cue-timed motion
prerequisite: Learner can resolve a velocity into x and y components and knows g = 9.8 m/s^2 downward.
success_check: Learner predicts vy = 0 at the apex and checks it against the readout before replaying, then compares with the landing readout.

scenes.title: Cue-timed apex callout
scenes.concept_target: At the apex the vertical component vy is zero while the horizontal component vx is unchanged, and the callout lands exactly on the apex cue.

narration_cues.text: Launch. The projectile leaves at eight metres per second and forty-five degrees. Watch the horizontal component vx stay constant while the vertical component vy starts large. This cue timing sets up the flight in SI units.
narration_cues.change: Axes, full trajectory, projectile at the launch point, and the vx and vy arrows with readouts appear.

narration_cues.text: Apex. At the top of the arc the vertical velocity vy is zero while vx carries the projectile forward. The apex marker appears exactly on this cue, at the apex frame.
narration_cues.change: The projectile travels to the top of the arc and the apex callout fades in exactly as vy reaches zero.

narration_cues.text: Landing. Gravity has pulled vy negative, mirror to launch, while vx is unchanged and the range reads about six point five metres. The cue timing closes as the dot touches down; predict the landing spot before replaying, then compare.
narration_cues.change: The projectile descends to the ground, the vy arrow flips downward, and the range note appears.
